senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. דֵּעָה) knowledge, mind; temperament, physical disposition, constitution. עלתה על ד׳ to occur to one’s mind, to strike.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:6">Sot. IX, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 45b:20">45ᵇ</cite>); a. fr.—<he>שיקול הד׳</he> weighing of opinions, i.e. decision between opposite views.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 6a">Snh. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>טעה בש׳ הד׳</he> made a mistake in deciding, against the common practice, a case concerning which there are opposite authorities, opp. to a decision against an established law; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 33a">ib. 33ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 9:5:3">Y. Keth. IX, 33ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:1:10">Y. Snh. I, 18ᵃ</cite> bot.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:9">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> top <he>אין דַּעְתָּן נקיה</he> their mind is not pure (unfit to study esoterics).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 11b:7">B. Mets. 11ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ד׳ אחרת מקנה</he> a deputized person (or fictitious person, e.g. one’s ground) can take possession.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 25a">Snh. 25ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>תולה בד׳ עצמו</he> one who makes the chance of a game dependent on his own action, e.g. throwing dice, <he>תולה בד׳ יונו</he> who makes it dependent on his dove’s flight.—

Tosef. Ḥull. VII, 1 וד׳ מכרעת reason decides in favor &c.; Ḥull. 90ᵇ מאי ד׳ ד׳ תורה by saying ‘reason decides’ does he mean a reasonable interpretation of the Biblical law, or is he in doubt and ‘reason decides’ means ד׳ נוטה his opinion inclines in favor of &c.?—מִדַּ׳, לַדַּ׳ with the consent of, with the knowledge of, opp. בעל כרח־, v. כּוֹרַח.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 44a:1">Kidd. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>מד׳ אביה</he> with her father’s consent; <he>מִדַּעְתָּהּ</he> with her consent.
Ib. שלא לד׳ אביה without her father’s consent; a. fr.—ד׳ יפה good physical constitution, מי שדעתו י׳ not fastidious in taste, opp. אִיסְתְּנִיס q. v.—ד׳ קצרה impatience, greed, ד׳ רחבה contentedness.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 145b">B. Bath. 145ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a:17">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite> top.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 29b:10">Ber. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>דַּעְתָּם קצרה</he> they are impatient (Rashi: they do not understand how to express their wishes).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 113b:16">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>אין הד׳ סובלתן</he> whom the mind cannot endure; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דֵּעוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="D00943"><he>דֵּעָה</he></cite>.
